review.question_leak_note: The question presents observed KPI values and asks for the root cause without hinting at uplink congestion or scheduler dynamics.
review.evidence_note: The KPIs show a large increase in uplink buffer backlog (1,174 to 8,071, ~6.9x) paired with a much smaller relative increase in scheduled UL resource blocks (7.1 to 13.8, ~1.9x), while RF conditions (RSRP, UL SNR) remain essentially stable. This strongly supports uplink buffer backlog and network congestion.
